Situated in the heart of Gugulethu, a Cape Town township whose name means "Our Pride", Mzoli's is one of the most popular hangouts in the Mother City. The establishment was founded in 2003 by Mzoli Ngcawuzele, who owns the place. The Development Bank of South Africa gave Ngcawuzele funding to start the business. The establishment started humbly as a small butchery operated from Ngcawuzele's garage. Over the years, the establishment has grown and has become one of the most popular entertainment spots in Cape Town. Mzoli's has a vast range of customers, both local and international.
